skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the historical development of economic theories and their impact on economic practices.
Conduct independent research on economic theories and their applications.
Analyze and critique various economic theories and their implications.
Effectively communicate economic theories and their applications.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and discussions.
Develop self-learning skills to understand and apply economic theories.
Analyze economic data and trends using historical economic theories.
Analyze economic policies using historical economic theories.
Understand and apply various economic theories in real-world contexts.
Understand the historical context of economic theories and their evolution.
